name: A scaled copy's ArmorDamageModifier split never underflows the unsigned armor (#9342)
contract: Stonefist Girdle (6742, armor 234, ArmorDamageModifier 100) is the second choice of quest 1101 'The Crone of the Kraul' (min level 23). Player::_ApplyItemBonuses subtracted the item's ArmorDamageModifier from the ladder row's reborn armor on a uint32 without saturating; at a low scaling key the reborn armor is below the modifier (100) and the subtraction wrapped to about 4.29e9, applied as a garbage flat armor modifier. A level-26 Witch Hunter who receives the belt from this quest stores scaling key 22 (the quest's own QuestTemplateScaling.dbc curve, not the character's raw level; measured with the harness, not assumed) and its ladder row's reborn armor is 77, below the modifier, exercising the saturating path. The reward auto-equips the belt, so the snapshot is taken before the reward. A level-60 character given the authored copy directly (no scaling key; add_item does not auto-equip) is a control: its ItemAddon.dbc reborn armor (206) already exceeds the modifier, so the split there was never starved and its delta is unaffected by the fix.

steps.label: SETUP: the belt stores its scaling key
SETUP: the reward auto-equips the belt
DISCRIMINATING: equipping adds exactly its ladder row's reborn armor, not a wrapped value
authored-copy control has no scaling key
the authored copy's own armor is unaffected by the fix
